notes: Answer key for the ai-quality-watchdog loop. The expected PASS/FAIL per example was computed mechanically by applying eval-set.json's must_contain / must_not_contain criteria to tonight-outputs.json; recompute if either fixture changes.

run.prompt:
/ai-quality-watchdog

Run this loop end to end, non-interactively. Run MAKER.md as one agent, then CHECKER.md as a separate fresh agent that never sees the maker's reasoning. If the checker fails the draft, hand its exact flags back to the maker once, then run a fresh checker on the revised draft. Do not ask questions; finish the run.

cases.title: Model update night: one confirmed regression, three new failures with a shared cause, two clears
cases.scenario: Night of 2026-07-16 after gpt-shim v2.4.2 deployed 2026-07-15 17:40 PT. Pass rate falls below the 7-day average by more than 5 points, so an alert is due. Traps: EX-007's output quotes an em dash; EX-024 and EX-019 have prior failures and must not be called new; two examples cleared and both must be listed; EX-019 is truncated but still produced an output.
cases.reference:
Tonight (2026-07-16): 24 of 30 passed = 80.0%. Failures (literal criteria, no partial credit): EX-007 (claims Enterprise has a free trial), EX-011, EX-018, EX-026 (Spanish questions answered in English, so the required Spanish terms are missing), EX-019 (truncated mid-sentence, missing CSV and PNG), EX-024 (says admins can view all boards).
7-day average 2026-07-09..2026-07-15 = 89.0% to 89.1% (187/210 = 89.048%, or mean of nightly rates = 89.057%). Drop about 9.0 to 9.1 points, more than 5, so the alert fires.
Alert grouping:
- Confirmed regression (3+ consecutive nights): EX-007 (4th consecutive night: 07-13, 07-14, 07-15, 07-16).
- New failures tonight: exactly EX-011, EX-018, EX-026. Shared pattern: Spanish-language questions answered in English, first seen right after gpt-shim v2.4.2 (deployed 2026-07-15 17:40 PT).
- Ongoing / known-intermittent: EX-024 (pattern log: failed 4 of last 7 nights) and EX-019 (pattern log: failed once on 07-11, truncation, latency-sensitive).
- Cleared tonight: EX-022 and EX-029 (both failed 2026-07-15, both passed tonight). Nothing else.
Owner for suggested actions: priya.raman@tasklane.io (eval-set.json owner field). Alert links point to runs/ai-quality-watchdog/nightly-2026-07-16.md, never to harness or eval output files.
State: the append goes to runs/ai-quality-watchdog/STATE.md; the fixture .claude/skills/ai-quality-watchdog/STATE.md is never edited.

Report format: summary, then Bottom Line, before any other section.

Alert rules: exactly these headings, in this order.
Numbers recomputed from raw data: 24/30.
7-day rolling average recomputed from history.csv, not last night alone.

Known failure 2026-07-16: alert linked a harness path.
Known failure 2026-07-16: cleared flags reported selectively.

criteria.question: Does the report compare tonight's pass rate to the 7-day rolling average, state a drop of about 9 points (9.0 or 9.1), and include or reference a Slack alert for #product because the drop exceeds 5 points?
criteria.why: Threshold: alert on a drop of more than 5 points vs the 7-day average.

criteria.question: Is EX-007 listed under 'Confirmed regression (3+ consecutive nights)' and not under 'New failures tonight'?
criteria.why: Escalation rule: 3+ consecutive nights is a confirmed regression.

criteria.question: Is the 'New failures tonight' group exactly EX-011, EX-018 and EX-026, with no other example IDs in it?
criteria.why: Known failure 2026-07-16: an intermittent example was filed under New.

criteria.question: Does the report identify that the new failures share one pattern (Spanish questions answered in English) and connect it to the gpt-shim v2.4.2 deploy of 2026-07-15?
criteria.why: The insight a PM needs: one root cause behind three failures, tied to the change that caused it.

criteria.question: Is EX-024 under 'Ongoing / known-intermittent' (not New) with its pattern-log count quoted (failed 4 of last 7 nights, or an updated count derived from it)?
criteria.why: Intermittent counts from the pattern log must be cited.

criteria.question: Is EX-019 kept out of 'New failures tonight' and treated as ongoing or known-intermittent, citing its prior failure on 2026-07-11?
criteria.why: Prior failures never go under New.

criteria.question: Does 'Cleared tonight' list EX-022 and EX-029 and no example that failed tonight?
criteria.why: Cleared list must be exhaustive and correct.

criteria.question: Does the report give a PASS or FAIL with a one-line reason for every one of the 30 examples (in a table or appendix)?
criteria.why: Checker criteria: every example ran, every score has a one-line reason.
